description: emulateapj (CTAN, 2025/02/19; MiKTeX package emulateapj), the ApJ two-column look built on REVTeX, two columns by default. The revtex4 option makes it load REVTeX 4.0 straight away. That is MiKTeX's revtex4 package, v4.0a 2020/09/30, which is patched for the 2020-10 kernel. MiKTeX has no revtex4-1, so the class's \IfFileExists{revtex4-1.cls} would fall back to the same file anyway. The preamble is empty: \journalinfo, \submitted and the running heads have defaults, and an author with no \affiliation only gives a warning. Its preamble takes four of aastex.json's lines, each checked against MiKTeX's revtex4.cls: the float end with ltxgrid's vertical-mode case (REVTeX 4.0's own \end@@float at l.2493 lacks it), \@mkpream@relax relaxing \@endpbox, \switch@array relaxed (the "Extra \or" in array tables), and the contents names. Not aastex's footnote line: it needs \set@footnotefont, which REVTeX 4.0 does not have. The last line undoes ltcaption's longtable* right after caption loads it, so REVTeX's longtable patch at \begin{document} can define it ("Command \longtable* already defined" in every cell that loaded caption, first batch 2 run). The last two lines redefine REVTeX 4.0's \make@footnotetext and \@makefntext with the same bodies as \long, so a footnote of two paragraphs no longer stops at "Paragraph ended before ..." (round b27: 1,205 branches; probe run 41966202031: 0 errors). \addtocontents is made \long the same way: scrlayer-notecolumn writes every note through REVTeX 4.0's \addtocontents, which took no paragraph (round b27: 4,792 branches; fix session's probe: 6 and 11 errors before, 0 after). The last line sets the paper size, which emulateapj leaves at 0pt, so every sentinel read as off the paper (probe run 41972817702: paper 0.0pt and 207 and 196 overfull or off-paper lines before; 614.295pt by 794.97pt and 4 and 18 after, the same sentinels, no errors).
